description: Dashboard migration: rename CompanyContext.tsx to OrganizationContext.tsx, expose currentOrg and orgs[] from memberships using the /organizations endpoint, update layout.tsx, update all /api/companies references to /api/organizations, update company.service.ts and company.types.ts references, and update dashboard pages that consume useCompany(). FEAT-003 is independent of FEAT-002 (API changes) but depends on the /organizations endpoint existing (it already does from Phase 0). This is a pure frontend change — no Python files touched. NOTE: Next.js version is 16.3.7 with React 19 (App Router). Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ if unsure about any API before writing code.
steps: Step 1 — Read dashboard/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ to confirm any App Router APIs used. Specifically confirm: 'use client' directive, useContext, useCallback, useEffect are still the correct patterns for React 19 / Next.js 16. Confirm that localStorage access in useEffect is still the correct pattern for SSR-safe client-side storage.

Step 2 — Create dashboard/app/lib/contexts/OrganizationContext.tsx as a new file. This replaces CompanyContext.tsx functionally but keep CompanyContext.tsx as a thin re-export shim to avoid breaking imports that haven't been updated yet. OrganizationContext.tsx should:
  - Export interface OrgContextValue { orgId: string; currentOrg: Organization | null; orgs: Organization[]; loadingOrg: boolean; orgError: string | null; setOrgId: (id: string) => void; }
  - Export OrganizationProvider component that on token available: fetches GET /api/v1/organizations/ (using fetch with Authorization header) and stores orgs[]. Restores selected orgId from localStorage key 'synthetiq_selected_org'. Falls back to user.org_id from SessionContext if nothing stored. Exposes setOrgId that updates localStorage and re-fetches the org profile.
  - Export useOrganization(): OrgContextValue hook (useContext)
  - Organization type imported from '../types/organization.types' (already has org_id, name, etc.)
  - STORAGE_KEY = 'synthetiq_selected_org' (different from the old 'synthetiq_selected_company' to avoid stale data conflicts)

Step 4 — Update dashboard/app/layout.tsx: change `import { CompanyProvider } from './lib/contexts/CompanyContext'` to `import { OrganizationProvider } from './lib/contexts/OrganizationContext'`. Replace `<CompanyProvider>` with `<OrganizationProvider>` and `</CompanyProvider>` with `</OrganizationProvider>`.

Step 5 — Update dashboard/app/lib/services/company.service.ts to point at /organizations instead of /companies:
  - listCompanies() → calls GET /api/v1/organizations/ (returns Organization[] — compatible shape since Organization has org_id, name, gstin, etc.)
  - getCompany(companyId) → calls GET /api/v1/organizations/{companyId} (using org_id)
  - createCompany() → calls POST /api/v1/organizations/
  Rename methods to listOrganizations/getOrganization/createOrganization and keep old names as aliases for backward compatibility: `listCompanies = this.listOrganizations; getCompany = this.getOrganization`.
  Change return types from Company to Organization (import from '../types/organization.types').

Step 6 — Update dashboard/app/page.tsx: change `import { useCompany } from './lib/contexts/CompanyContext'` to keep working via shim (no change needed if shim exports useCompany). BUT update the destructured properties: the old CompanyContext had `{ companyId, company }` — the new OrgContextValue has `{ orgId, currentOrg }`. In page.tsx find `const { companyId, company } = useCompany()` and replace with `const { orgId: companyId, currentOrg: company } = useOrganization()` (import useOrganization from OrganizationContext) so the rest of the file works unchanged. The handleLaunch() call passes `company_id: companyId` to complianceSvc.runE2E — this still works since companyId is now org_id.

Step 7 — Update dashboard/app/organizations/page.tsx: it currently imports { useSession } and makes raw fetch calls to /api/v1/organizations/. This is fine. No changes needed here except: the 'Add Team Member' dialog currently POSTs to /organizations/{orgId}/users/ without a password field but the CreateUserRequest requires password. Update the handleInviteUser() function to instead POST to /api/v1/organizations/{orgId}/invites (the new invite endpoint from FEAT-002) with { email: newEmail, role: newRole, purpose: 'invite' } — this avoids needing a password field at invite time. Update the dialog UI to remove the Name field (invite flow does not need display_name at invite creation time). Update the feedback message accordingly.

Step 8 — Check all remaining dashboard pages for CompanyContext usage. Scan these files for 'useCompany' or 'companyId' or 'CompanyContext':
  - dashboard/app/agents/page.tsx
  - dashboard/app/agents/config/page.tsx
  - dashboard/app/auction/page.tsx
  - dashboard/app/dispatch/page.tsx
  - dashboard/app/liability/page.tsx
  - dashboard/app/settlement/page.tsx
  - dashboard/app/schedules/page.tsx
  For each file that uses useCompany() and destructures companyId: update to also destructure `orgId` OR use the shim (which exports useCompany pointing to useOrganization). Because the shim exports useCompany and OrgContextValue has orgId (not companyId), you must map the destructure. The safest approach: in each consuming page, add `const orgId = companyId` after the destructure, or rename destructure to `const { orgId: companyId, currentOrg: company } = useOrganization()`. Read each file to confirm actual usage before editing.

Step 9 — Update dashboard/app/lib/hooks/useServices.ts: ensure useCompanyService() still works (it does via shim). Add/confirm useOrganizationService() is exported (it already is in the current file).
Step 10 — Run `cd dashboard && npm run build` to confirm no TypeScript errors. Fix any type errors found before marking complete.
acceptance_criteria: cd dashboard && npm run build completes without TypeScript errors
OrganizationContext.tsx exists and exports OrganizationProvider and useOrganization
CompanyContext.tsx is a shim re-exporting from OrganizationContext.tsx
page.tsx (dashboard root) uses orgId/currentOrg from useOrganization without runtime errors
